title: MAMA metric card
description: Versioned definition of one MAMA (Measuring Automation & Measuring Autonomy) automation/value/impact metric. Cards define measurement; they never prescribe universal targets and never mix with `mama` autonomy outputs.

schema_version.description: Version of this metric-card schema the card validates against.

id.description: Stable slug; survives renames; never reused by a different measure.

version.description: Card semver. Formula/denominator/inclusion changes require a MAJOR bump and a migration note.

status.description: Artifact status label per org governance.

purpose.description: What this measure describes, in plain language.

decision_use.description: The investment/operating decision this metric informs. Metrics without a decision use are not admitted.

formula.description: Explicit computation: numerator over denominator, or the counting rule. Must be reproducible from the stated source.

unit.description: Unit of the result: percent, ratio, milliseconds, currency/time, index points, count.

denominator.description: Exactly what the denominator counts. The most common source of incomparability; must be explicit.

inclusions.description: What counts in numerator and denominator.

exclusions.description: What is excluded and why. Empty array is allowed but must be a conscious choice.

data_source.description: System(s) of record and the extraction approach. Local-first; no centralized telemetry required.

sampling.description: Census or sampling design; if sampled, method and size rationale.

time_window.description: Default reporting window and alignment rules (calendar vs rolling).

owner_role.description: Role accountable for this card's definition and data quality. Must not be the benefit claimant (roles.md separation).

baseline_requirement.description: What a valid baseline for this metric requires (window, comparability, recording).

target_guidance.description: How a use case sets its own target. MUST NOT state a universal target.

uncertainty.description: Sources of error/variation and how to express them (CI, ranges, counts).

limitations.description: Known failure modes of interpretation — at minimum the gaming/misreading risks.

review_cadence.description: How often the card's definition and data quality are re-checked.

related_metrics.description: Card IDs commonly reported alongside this one (balance set).

adverse_use_warnings.description: What this metric must NOT be used for (e.g. ranking, proxies, quotas).

references.description: Framework docs, upstream sources, or prior art with versions.
